title: Edge count lower bound from a minimum degree
statement:
Let $G$ be a loopless multigraph with finite vertex set $V$ and edge multiset $E$, and let $k$ be a natural number. If every vertex $v \in V$ has degree at least $k$ in $G$, then
\[
  k \cdot \abs{V} \le 2\,\abs{E},
\]
where $\abs{V}$ is the number of vertices and $\abs{E}$ is the number of edges counted with multiplicity.
hypotheses_covered: G is a loopless multigraph with finite vertex set
every vertex of G has degree at least k
replaced:
If every vertex of $G$ has degree at least $k$, then
\[
  k \cdot \abs{V(G)} \le 2\abs{E(G)} .
\]
